notes.title: HOTFIX: Version 1.01 is live!
notes.content:
Hey all, we got a few bug reports and are going to be making a few fixes this week to account for them. Here's what we did this build:

FIXES:
-Fixed a bug in survival mode where some users started out in the wrong waves.
-Added a 32 bit version of Grave VR

We'll let you know as we make more updates but please let us know anything you have an issue with in the discussions and we'll get on it ASAP!
